text:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR 31234 updates the merge/eviction orchestration. Need cross-team reviewers: runtime (kv/cache changes), infra (autoscaler tweak), security (privileged k8s role). Hoping to merge during the 10:30 PT canary window tomorrow. @mira @sam @jin PTAL? :wave:

mira: I can do runtime review. Is there a short summary of perf impact?

alex: Perf note: small increase in async eviction loop I/O, expect ~5% CPU bump in worst-case. Tests included. See diff: https://git.internal/r/31234

sam: Infra can look too — but need to confirm autoscaler backoff param. If we keep current backoff it should be fine.

jin: Security will need explicit justification for the new ClusterRole binding. Can you paste the RBAC snippet here?

alex: here's snippet:
```yaml
kind: ClusterRole
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods", "events"]
    verbs: ["get","list"]
``` 
Just for eviction telemetry read-only.

jin: That helps. Add a comment in the PR describing least-privilege rationale and I'll sign off if tests pass.

nina: Heads-up — deploy-bot shows canary window 10:30-11:00 PT is open. I'll reserve slot once we have approvals.

security-bot: Secret scan: no new secrets found. Static analysis: one low-severity hardcoded timeout flagged (see PR thread).

mira: I'll post inline comments by 4pm PT; if nothing major, mark LGTM for runtime.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll validate autoscaler config and reply before EOD.

alex: Thanks all — plan: merge tomorrow if runtime+infra+security have LGTM by 09:30 PT. I'll add checklist to PR. /cc @nina

nina: Copy. Reserving canary and will DM with rollout playbook.
